item.title: New Zealanders vote to elect 120 members of the House of Representatives, with 11 additional overhang seats.
item.description:
New Zealanders vote to elect 120 members of the House of Representatives, with 11 additional overhang seats. National Party leader Christopher Luxon and Labour leader Chris Hipkins both seek reappointment as the country's prime minister. Preliminary results see Labour lead in the popular vote and the Nationals having the most amount of seats, with special votes yet to be counted.

Sources: AP, RNZ
